# replace

<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW142521531 BCX8" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; user-select: text; -webkit-user-drag: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;">此功能有助于使用正则表达式将部分文本字符串替换为不同的文本字符串。</span><span data-ccp-props="{201341983:0,335559739:160,335559740:259}" class="EOP SCXW142521531 BCX8" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; user-select: text; -webkit-user-drag: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: left; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; white-space: pre-wrap; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 19.425px; font-family: Calibri, Calibri_EmbeddedFont, Calibri_MSFontService, sans-serif;"> </span>

## <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW13112935 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; user-select: text; -webkit-user-drag: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;">句法</span>

`GC.REGEXREPLACE(text, regular_expression, replacement, [modifiers])`

| `text` | 指的是您要替换的文本。该函数可以输入字符串、单元格引用或单元格范围引用。 |
| `regular_expression` | 替换文本的所有匹配实例的正则表达式。 |
| `replacement` | 指根据regular\_expression可以插入的代替原文的文字。 |

## <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW13112935 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; user-select: text; -webkit-user-drag: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;">例子</span><span class="EOP SCXW13112935 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{134245418:true,134245529:true,201341983:0,335559738:40,335559739:0,335559740:259}" style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; user-select: text; -webkit-user-drag: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 19.425px; font-family: Calibri, Calibri_MSFontService, sans-serif; color: rgb(47, 84, 150);"> </span>

`GC.REGEXREPLACE("SpreadJS Worksheet", "s.*t", "book")`给出结果 SpreadJS Worksheet
`GC.REGEXREPLACE("12/23/2022", "(\d{2})/(\d{2})/(\d{4})", "$3-$1-$2")`给出结果 2022-12-23
`GC.REGEXREPLACE("John-Smith", "(\w{4})-(\w{5})", "$2 $1")`给出结果 Smith John
